'''Carquinyoli''' are Catalan [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookies]] much like biscotti.

==Ingredients==
* 150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 100 g granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], [[Cookbook:Zester|zested]]
* 125 g whole raw [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
* 1 egg, beaten

== Procedure ==
#Combine the flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
#Combine the egg, sugar, and lemon zest. [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] until very foamy. 
#Stir the flour mixture and almonds into the egg mixture to get a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. 
#Shape the dough into two flattened logs of about 6 x 3 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] on a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. 
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the dough with the beaten egg. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven at moderate heat (180°C) for 25 minutes. 
#While still hot, cut the baked dough into thin slices less than 1 cm thick. Arrange slices on baking sheets without letting them touch.
#Bake them for 5 minutes more in the oven to brown their surfaces.
#Allow to cool before eating.

steps.text: Combine the flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
Combine the egg, sugar, and lemon zest. Whip until very foamy.
Stir the flour mixture and almonds into the egg mixture to get a dough.
Shape the dough into two flattened logs of about 6 x 3 cm on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Brush the dough with the beaten egg.
Bake in the oven at moderate heat (180°C) for 25 minutes.
While still hot, cut the baked dough into thin slices less than 1 cm thick. Arrange slices on baking sheets without letting them touch.
Bake them for 5 minutes more in the oven to brown their surfaces.
